description: NuSTAR 3-79 keV spectrum of the Compton-thick AGN NGC 1365 (ObsID 60002046002, 36.3 ks, full-frame; the previous 60002046001 is a 32x32 subframe with X/Y=-1 and cannot drive numkrmf): absorbed cutoff power law with and without a Compton reflection component, plus an Fe K-alpha line. The band above 20 keV is what the XMM/RXTE tools cannot reach.
